title: tithymalus × gayeri
intro: Tithymalus × gayeri, commonly known as Euphorbia, is a hybrid species of spurge plant in the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a succulent plant, often used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tithymalus × gayeri include anti-inflammatory and anti-bacterial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and diterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
